label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows through replace('-->') sanitization to response.getWriter(). The resolved sink value is '<!-- USER_INPUT_WITHOUT_-->> -->'. Attacker can bypass by sending '-->' followed by malicious script (e.g., '--><script>alert(1)</script>'). Since replace removes '-->', the injected script closes the comment delimiter and executes. Comment wrapping does not mitigate XSS when delimiter stripping is used instead of proper encoding.

evidence.note: param from request.getParameter flows to response.getWriter() with only delimiter strip, allowing bypass via '--><script>' payload
